title: Shaded relief of the land from the ASTER global digital elevation model, for detail at close range
provider: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), from the ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model (NASA and METI, Japan)
licence: NASA imagery: no restrictions on use; acknowledge NASA GIBS and the data source (NASA Earthdata use policy). ASTER GDEM is a product of METI and NASA.
credit: NASA GIBS, ASTER GDEM (METI and NASA)

layer.description: GIBS layer of grey shaded relief

width.description: Width of the global image in pixels (360°)

height.description: Height of the global image in pixels (180°)

preview.description: A global image of 2048 x 1024; the detail comes from the service, region by region

format: PNG, grey, equirectangular (EPSG:4326). Flat land is a middle grey, lit from the north-west; water and areas without data are one uniform darker grey.
coverage: Land between about 83° N and 83° S at 1 arc second (about 30 m), from ASTER stereo images of 2000-2013
citation: NASA/METI/AIST/Japan Spacesystems and U.S./Japan ASTER Science Team (2019). ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003. NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC; shaded relief through NASA GIBS.
